Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 1.1: Assisting a Friend Moving Near Your University
Nội dung chi tiết:
You have received an email from your friend, Daniel, who is preparing to move into a rented apartment near your university. Read part of his email below:

"I am moving to a new apartment near your university next weekend! Since you are familiar with the area, could you recommend a reliable moving company or delivery service to help me transport my belongings? Would you be available to give me a hand on the moving day? Also, could you tell me a little bit about what the neighborhood and neighbors are like there? Thanks so much!"

Write an email responding to Daniel.

body.answer: I believe you should book Lalamove or AhaMove small truck delivery service to transport your furniture and boxes.
body.example: Last month, my cousin used their mini-van service for 300,000 VND, and all his belongings arrived safely within an hour.
body.reason: Their app service is fast, convenient for busy people, and fits comfortably within a student's budget without hidden charges.
body.requirement: Recommend a reliable moving company or delivery service

body.answer: I would like to let you know that I am completely free next Saturday morning from 8:00 AM to noon to give you a hand.
body.example: I can ride my motorbike over early to help you carry boxes and set up your study desk.
body.reason: Moving into a new place alone is tiring, and helping each other builds a strong sense of belonging between friends.
body.requirement: Availability to help on moving day

body.answer: I would like to give you information on the neighborhood: it is safe, lively, and full of friendly families and university students.
body.example: Right downstairs, there is a 24-hour convenience store and a quiet park where people jog every afternoon.
body.frame: D. Provide Information + H. Provide Opinion
body.reason: Having helpful neighbors and cheap local markets nearby helps newcomers adjust and adapt to the new environment quickly.
body.requirement: Describe what the neighborhood and neighbors are like

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 2.1: Advantages and Disadvantages of Religious Tourism
Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"Religious tourism, also known as spiritual tourism, where people travel to sacred sites, temples, pagodas, and pilgrimage destinations, has grown rapidly in many parts of the world."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the advantages and disadvantages of religious tourism for individuals and local communities. Include specific reasons and examples from your knowledge or experience to support your view.
title: Task 2.1: Advantages and Disadvantages of Religious Tourism
content:
Read the following statement:

"Religious tourism, also known as spiritual tourism, where people travel to sacred sites, temples, pagodas, and pilgrimage destinations, has grown rapidly in many parts of the world."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the advantages and disadvantages of religious tourism for individuals and local communities. Include specific reasons and examples from your knowledge or experience to support your view.

body1.example: For instance, during spring festivals at Yen Tu Pagoda, tourists feel peaceful and happy, while local families earn good income from selling food and souvenirs.
body1.focus: Advantages for individuals and local communities
body1.frame: Firstly, the first reason is that [ld1] + Advantages chunks + A-R-E Mental health & Knowledge
body1.point: Visiting temples and pagodas helps travelers relieve stress and reduce fatigue while broadening their mind about local culture and traditions. For local communities, more visitors boost economic development and improve people's living standard.

body2.example: For example, on big holiday weekends at famous pagodas, travelers often get stuck in long lines, pay high hotel prices, and see plastic trash around the temple yard.
body2.focus: Disadvantages for individuals and local communities
body2.frame: Secondly, [debai] has a negative impact on... + Disadvantages chunks + Environmental protection
body2.point: However, too many visitors at sacred sites can cause overcrowding, traffic jams, and littering, which harms environmental protection. Also, long pilgrimage trips cost a great deal of money, time, and effort for travelers.

hint.conclusion: In conclusion, religious tourism can have both pros and cons: while it helps travelers feel peaceful and boosts local income, communities must protect the environment and manage large crowds carefully.

intro.ld1: improve mental health, learn about local culture, and boost economic development
intro.ld2: face overcrowding, high travel costs, and pollution at sacred sites
